### John Stuart Mill on happiness

John Stuart Mill (1806–1873) approaches happiness within Utilitarianism / liberalism. Mill’s harm principle limits interference with liberty; higher and lower pleasures revise Benthamite calculation; and The Subjection of Women argues for equality. Representative government and free discussion are institutional ideals. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets happiness most directly—useful for searches such as “john stuart mill quotes on happiness.”
